herbal_tea.name: Herbal Tea
herbal_tea.description: A simple steeping of herb extract in water. No yeast, no fermentation, just warmth and time.

honey_mead.name: Honey Mead
honey_mead.description: Wild honey dissolved in spring water and left to ferment in the dark. The oldest brew known.

nun_beer.name: Nun Beer
nun_beer.description: A dark malt-style brew made from honey and bottled water, fermented slow and cold like the monastery cellars.

varlenias_wine.name: Varlenia's Wine
varlenias_wine.description: A ruby-gold wine pressed from golden sunfruit, aged with a touch of wild honey for sweetness.

aged_wine.name: Aged Wine
aged_wine.description: Crystal nectar fruit blended with royal meat honey produces a luxurious vintage that demands patience.

ethanol.name: Ethanol
ethanol.description: A potent distillate fermented from Dragon's Breath Fruit and Void Starfruit. Dangerously pure alcohol.
